observed_bottleneck: Parent n-6174d6127af5 stops clean corpus pretraining after five epochs even though its seed-0 token NLL falls monotonically from 1.0043740272521973 at epoch one to 0.6764117479324341 at epoch five, with the final step still improving from 0.693612277507782. Node n-b992903add3b reproduces terminal epoch-five NLL values of 0.6764117479324341, 0.6806491017341614, and 0.676954984664917 across the three preparations, so the limiting active-layer behavior is a fixed early stop without evidence that clean next-token fitting has plateaued. Other active-layer attempts do not settle this mechanism: n-b992903add3b selected checkpoints for broad ancestral support but reduced macro score by 0.008551034406275007, n-7a4ed835db7f expanded corpus coverage and raised the weakest online support while reducing macro score by 0.02463049649027767, and n-2661e5071749's noisy-prefix training was refuted. The distinct test here is additional optimization on exactly the Parent's clean reservoir and objective, not another support selector, corpus expansion, or denoising input.
hypothesis: Continue the Parent's otherwise unchanged clean corpus-prior teacher-forcing schedule for three additional passes, increasing total pretraining from five to eight epochs so the autoregressive GRU can further reduce unresolved corpus next-token uncertainty before its weights are frozen.
method_name: Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization
method_thesis: Pretrain an autoregressive SMILES language model on the allowed unlabeled corpus and freeze a copy as the molecular prior. During each objective session, sample complete molecules de novo token by token from a trainable agent, rank the accepted molecules by their observed oracle rewards, and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction using the Augmented Hill-Climb loss: the squared gap between agent log-likelihood and a target formed from prior log-likelihood plus scaled reward. Excluding low-reward samples from policy updates prevents them from repeatedly pulling the agent back toward the prior, while prior likelihood still regularizes the elite updates; this concentrates the scarce feedback on sequences associated with improvement of final Top-1 without screening a finite molecular pool.
